name: charge_to_4v2
description: CC-CV charge to 4.20 V at the cell's standard 1C rate, terminating on the cell's 0.05 A taper
comment: 1C = 1.900 A for LP604765 (standard_charge_a). Target 4.20 V is the cell's nominal max_v, not the 4.25 V hard limit. Taper current is omitted on purpose so termination uses the cell's own charge_taper_a (0.05 A ~= C/38).
